
### Finite-State Automata for the notes of the Unit 1 - INTRODUCTION in the subject of NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING

* Finite-state automata (FSA) are a type of mathematical machine used to recognize patterns in strings.
* FSA are composed of a finite set of states, transitions between states, and a set of input symbols.
* FSA can be used to recognize regular languages, which are sets of strings that can be generated by a finite state machine.
* FSA can be used to recognize natural language utterances.
* FSA can be used to parse natural language input into a structured form for further processing.
* FSA are also used in speech recognition systems, such as those used in voice-controlled assistants.
